article.title: Five Delta Assembly members defect to APC
article.text: Five members of the Delta State House of Assembly on Wednesday defected from the Peoples Democratic Party to the All Progressives Congress. They include Hon. Ejiro Okoro-Fictional, representing Ughelli North I-Fictional State Constituency, and Hon. Tobore Ese-Fictional, representing Sapele-Fictional State Constituency. The Speaker announced their defection at plenary. "We have formally joined the APC," Okoro-Fictional told journalists afterwards.
